outlooks.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE LIKELY FROM NORTH DAKOTA INTO NORTHWESTERN MINNESOTA MONDAY AFTERNOON AND EVENING. SOME WIND GUSTS COULD BE PARTICULARLY DAMAGING. OTHER SEVERE HAIL AND WIND IS POSSIBLE ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF MINNESOTA AS WELL AS WESTERN WISCONSIN. ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS ARE ALSO POSSIBLE ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS AND ACROSS THE GREAT BASIN.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL LOSE AMPLITUDE AS IT SHIFTS NEWD ACROSS MT AND INTO CANADA DURING THE DAY. MEANWHILE...A SRN DISTURBANCE WILL MOVE OUT OF THE GREAT BASIN AND INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS BY LATE IN THE DAY...ENHANCING UPPER-LEVEL WINDS. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE WILL BE CENTERED ACROSS NRN SD AND SRN ND...WITH A COLD FRONT INTO THE CNTRL DAKOTAS BY 00Z. STRONG HEATING AND FORCING ALONG THIS FRONT WILL BE THE PRIMARY FOCUS FOR INITIATION OF AN INTENSE CLUSTER OF STORMS WHICH WILL BE FUELED BY STRONG INSTABILITY AND HAVE THE POTENTIAL OF GROWING UPSCALE WITH A SIGNIFICANT DAMAGING WIND THREAT ACROSS ND AND NWRN MN. ELSEWHERE...OTHER DAYTIME STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY STRONG OUTFLOW WINDS EXTENDING SWWD FROM THE NRN ROCKIES INTO THE GREAT BASIN ON THE PERIPHERY OF THE UPPER HIGH WHERE COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT AND SUFFICIENT MOISTURE WILL REMAIN.

sections.title: ND...MN...NERN SD AND WRN WI
sections.text: A POOL OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP DURING THE DAY DUE TO HEATING AND AIDED TO SOME DEGREE BY EVAPOTRANSPIRATION WITH AROUND 5000 J/KG MUCAPE. THE INITIAL ACTIVITY WILL FORM BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS WRN ND...AND WILL LIKELY GROW INTO A LARGER CLUSTER AS OUTFLOW PROPAGATES EWD. GIVEN SUCH LARGE INSTABILITY...VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE DESPITE WIND PROFILES FAVORABLE FOR MULTICELLS. THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT WILL INCREASE AS THE SYSTEM MATURES ACROSS ERN ND AND INTO NWRN MN. MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE STEEP WHICH WILL MAXIMIZE INSTABILITY BUT ALSO RESULT IN A RELATIVELY SHARP CAPPING GRADIENT ALONG THE SRN EDGE OF THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS NRN SD INTO CNTRL/SRN MN. A SEPARATE REGIME IS DEPICTED BY A FEW MODELS SUCH AS THE WRF-NMM AND THE GFS WHICH INCLUDES POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS NEAR THE WARM FRONT ACROSS W CNTRL/NWRN MN...PERHAPS AIDED BY A LEADING DISTURBANCE. CAPPING MAY INHIBIT ANY DEVELOPMENT HERE OR AT LEAST KEEP COVERAGE ISOLATED...ALTHOUGH VERY STRONG INSTABILITY WOULD STILL YIELD SEVERE HAIL...WIND...AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO.

sections.title: CNTRL AND SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: VERY STRONG HEATING BENEATH THE UPPER RIDGE WILL LEAD TO INVERTED-V SOUNDINGS WITH 500-1000 J/KG MUCAPE WITHIN A WEAK LEE TROUGH FROM WRN NEB INTO ERN NM/W TX. SHEAR WILL BE WEAK BUT ISOLATED STORMS APPEAR LIKELY DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON. ANY STORMS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE LOCALLY STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS. ..JEWELL.. 07/21/2014

outlooks.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE LIKELY FROM NORTH DAKOTA INTO WESTERN AND NORTHERN MINNESOTA AND NORTHERN SOUTH DAKOTA THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. SOME WIND GUSTS COULD BE PARTICULARLY DAMAGING. OTHER STORMS WITH SEVERE WIND AND HAIL MAY OCCUR OVER REMAINDER OF MINNESOTA AND OVER PARTS OF WISCONSIN AND UPPER MICHIGAN. ISOLATED STORMS WITH STRONG WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS...AND OVER THE GREAT BASIN.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: MODERATE WSW FLOW WILL PREVAIL ACROSS THE NRN RCKYS...THE NRN PLNS AND UPR MS VLY THIS PERIOD...ON NRN FLANK OF UPR RIDGE BUILDING NEWD FROM THE SRN RCKYS. WITHIN THIS FLOW...SATELLITE AND VWP DATA SUGGEST PRESENCE OF SEVERAL LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCES THAT WILL TRACK ACROSS THE REGION. ONE OF THESE...NOW OVER ERN WY...SHOULD CONTINUE ENE INTO THE ERN DAKOTAS BY EVE AND TO LK SUPERIOR BY 12Z TUE AS ANOTHER...STRONGER IMPULSE MOVES FROM SE BC TO SRN MB. AT THE SFC...WEAK FRONTAL SURGES INTO THE NRN PLNS IN RECENT DAYS HAVE BECOME NEARLY STNRY THIS MORNING OVER THE DAKOTAS/MN. THE WSW-ENE ORIENTED BOUNDARIES SHOULD REMAIN MORE OR LESS STNRY THROUGH THE DAY AS WEAK CYCLOGENESIS OCCURS IN NRN SD...LARGELY IN RESPONSE TO PASSING UPR IMPULSE. THIS WAVE SHOULD TRACK NE TO NEAR DULUTH BY 12Z TUE...POSSIBLY AUGMENTED BY AN MCS-RELATED CIRCULATION OR MCV.

sections.title: NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: A POOL OF VERY UNSTABLE AIR /MLCAPE AOA 5000 J PER KG/ WILL EMERGE WITH STRONG SFC HEATING AND CONTINUED EVAPOTRANSPIRATION EXPECTED TODAY INVOF WEAK FRONTS STALLED WSW-ENE OVER ND AND CNTRL/NRN MN. CURRENT SFC AND SATELLITE DATA SUGGEST THAT COMBINATION OF HEATING AND ASCENT WITH WY IMPULSE COULD INITIATE STORMS BY MID TO LATE AFTN IN PARTS OF WRN AND CNTRL ND...WHERE LOW-LVL CONVERGENCE SHOULD BE MAXIMIZED ALONG AND N OF THE BOUNDARIES. GIVEN DEGREE OF BUOYANCY...THE STORMS LIKELY WILL QUICKLY BECOME SVR AS STORM OUTFLOW PREFERENTIALLY SPREADS E OR ENEWD. VERY LARGE HAIL...LOCALLY DMGG WIND...AND A COUPLE TORNADOES MAY OCCUR AS SUSTAINED STORMS...INCLUDING INTENSE MULTICELLS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS...ORGANIZE INTO CLUSTERS. A MORE ORGANIZED DAMAGING WIND/POTENTIAL DERECHO THREAT MAY DEVELOP BY EVE AS STORMS CONTINUE TO MERGE/DEVELOP EWD INTO ERN ND AND NRN/WRN MN. VERY STEEP MID-LVL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH STOUT EML INITIALLY MAY LIMIT ANY SEWD PROPAGATIONAL COMPONENT TO THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...ALTHOUGH WITH TIME AND EWD EXTENT...THE MCS AND ITS ASSOCIATED WIND THREAT ULTIMATELY COULD EXPAND A BIT SEWD...PERHAPS AS FAR AS NRN/WRN WI EARLY TUE. FARTHER S...A MORE CONDITIONAL/SPOR

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLNS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: VERY STRONG HEATING ALONG LEE TROUGH/DRY LINES SEGMENTS BENEATH THE UPR RIDGE WILL YIELD INVERTED-V SOUNDINGS WITH 500-1000 J/KG MUCAPE FROM WRN NEB SSW INTO ERN NM/W TX. SHEAR WILL BE WEAK. BUT ISOLD TO PERHAPS WDLY SCTD STORMS APPEAR LIKELY LATE THIS AFTN/EVE...AND THOSE THAT DO FORM WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS. ..CORFIDI/MOSIER.. 07/21/2014

outlooks.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE LIKELY FROM NORTH DAKOTA INTO WESTERN AND NORTHERN MINNESOTA THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. SOME WIND GUSTS COULD BE PARTICULARLY DAMAGING. sections.title: ND INTO MN/WI
sections.text: A BROAD UPPER RIDGE IS PRESENT TODAY OVER MUCH OF THE NATION...WITH THE BAND OF STRONGER WESTERLIES EXTENDING FROM THE NORTHERN ROCKIES ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS INTO ONTARIO. WATER VAPOR LOOPS AND RECENT MODEL RUNS SHOW A MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER EASTERN MT/WY WHICH WILL TRACK EASTWARD INTO THE DAKOTAS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. THIS FEATURE WILL BE THE PRIMARY FOCUS FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INITIATE DURING THE EARLY/MID AFTERNOON OVER SOUTHWEST ND NEAR A SURFACE LOW...OR IN THE BACKED LOW LEVEL WINDS JUST NORTH OF THE WARM FRONT IN CENTRAL ND. SURFACE DEWPOINTS NEAR 70F AND STRONG HEATING WILL HELP TO ELIMINATE THE CAP IN THIS REGION...AND YIELD MLCAPE VALUES OVER 3000 J/KG. INITIAL STORMS WILL LIKELY BE SUPERCELLULAR WITH A RISK OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS ISOLATED TORNADOES NEAR THE WARM FRONT. DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING...MODEL SOLUTIONS ARE IN STRONG AGREEMENT THAT ACTIVITY WILL ORGANIZE AND GROW UPSCALE INTO A FAST-MOVING BOWING COMPLEX THAT WILL TRACK EASTWARD ACROSS EASTERN ND INTO MN. THE TRACK OF THE BOW WILL LIKELY BE ALONG AND JUST SOUTH OF THE SURFACE WARM FRONT THAT CURRENTLY EXTENDS ROUGHLY FROM FAR-BJI-ELY.

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM WESTERN KS/EASTERN CO INTO NORTHEAST NM AND THE WESTERN OK/TX PANHANDLE. DESPITE WEAK FLOW ALOFT...MODERATE CAPE VALUES AND INVERTED-V THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES WILL SUPPORT A RISK OF ISOLATED STRONG STORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS. ..HART/COHEN.. 07/21/2014

sections.title: ND INTO MN/WI
sections.text: HI-RES MODEL GUIDANCE IN CONJUNCTION WITH CURRENT OBSERVATIONS CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ONGOING FORECAST FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS/DERECHO EVENT ACROSS CNTRL/ERN ND INTO NRN AND CNTRL MN THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. MINOR ADJUSTMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE MODERATE RISK AREA BASED ON LATEST SURFACE OBS...NAMELY THE LOCATION OF THE SFC WARM FRONT NEAR/JUST SOUTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER. THE MODERATE RISK HAS BEEN NUDGED NORTHWARD TO REFLECT THE LOCATION OF THE BOUNDARY AND BASED ON 18Z RAOB FROM INL. WHILE LATEST RADAR DATA INDICATES SOME WEAKENING IN ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS WRN ND...FURTHER ORGANIZATION AND STRENGTHENING IS EXPECTED AS STORM CLUSTERS TRACK EWD INTO STRONGER INSTABILITY IN A WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT WHERE EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS MAXIMIZED. FOR FURTHER DETAILS ON EXPECTED EVOLUTION...PLEASE SEE PREVIOUS DISCUSSION BELOW.

sections.text: NO CHANGES NEEDED. ..LEITMAN.. 07/21/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1126 AM CDT MON JUL 21 2014/ ...POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR A WIDESPREAD/SIGNIFICANT DAMAGING WIND EVENT /DERECHO/ THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER ND/MN...

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS MUCH OF MN INTO NWRN WI AND THE WRN U.P. OF MI...

sections.title: ERN ND INTO NRN MN AND NWRN WI
sections.text: AN ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CONTINUES TO EVOLVE EWD ACROSS SERN ND WITH OTHER SEVERE STORMS EXTENDING EWD ALONG A WARM FRONT FROM NERN ND INTO NWRN MN. DESPITE RELATIVELY MODEST WIND PROFILES...SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE AND VERY STRONG INSTABILITY SHOULD HELP THESE STORMS PERSIST WITH DAMAGING WINDS THE MOST PROMINENT THREAT. THE MORE CELLULAR ACTIVITY...SUCH AS THE STORMS NEAR THE GRAND FORKS AREA WILL ALSO HAVE A LARGE HAIL THREAT. IN ADDITION...BOUNDARY INTERACTIONS BOTH ALONG THE WARM FRONT AND ALONG THE LEADING GUST FRONT OF THE PRIMARY SYSTEM COULD RESULT IN A BRIEF TORNADO. OTHERWISE...THE GREATEST THREAT CORRIDOR SHOULD CONTINUE EWD ACROSS NRN MN...AND GRADUALLY WANE IN SEVERITY TOWARD LAKE SUPERIOR. FARTHER S...A SHARP GRADIENT TO THE SRN EDGE OF THE MCS IS EXPECTED DUE TO CAPPING. THE 00Z ABR AND MPX SOUNDINGS BOTH SHOWED A WARM LAYER AROUND 700 MB...WHICH WILL TEND TO INHIBIT DEVELOPMENT AWAY FROM THE DEEPER COLD POOLS.

sections.title: WRN KS INTO THE OK AND TX PANHANDLES
sections.text: SCATTERED STORMS NEAR A LOW PRESSURE TROUGH AND DRIVEN BY DAYTIME HEATING WILL LIKELY PERSIST FOR A FEW HOURS INTO THE EVENING WITH A LOCALIZED LARGE HAIL AND WIND THREAT. HOWEVER...THE OVERALL TREND WILL BE FOR FEWER STORMS BEYOND 01Z WITH LOSS OF HEATING AND INCREASING INHIBITION. ..JEWELL.. 07/22/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE/DEVELOP EAST-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS ND THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. THIS INCLUDES LARGE HAIL AND SOME TORNADO RISK....WITH WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL LIKELY INCREASINGLY LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. INCREASING CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL LIKELY PROMPT A WATCH ISSUANCE SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE UNDERWAY ACROSS FAR SOUTHWEST ND EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. COINCIDENT WITH THE LEADING EDGE OF INCREASING UPPER-LEVEL ASCENT PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...THESE STORMS ARE FOCUSED NORTH/NORTHWEST OF A SURFACE LOW AND AN ARCING SURFACE BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS ACROSS EASTERN MT AND ND. WHILE THIS STORMS ARE LIKELY INITIALLY ROOTED JUST ABOVE THE SURFACE...ADDITIONAL HEATING/ROBUST DESTABILIZATION SHOULD LEAD TO INCREASING SURFACE-BASED STORMS BY MID-AFTERNOON. LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY RISK INITIALLY...BUT A TORNADO OR TWO MAY ALSO BE POSSIBLE...WITH A MORE PREVALENT DAMAGING WIND EVENT OTHERWISE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE INTO THE LATE AFTERNOON/EVENING HOURS ACROSS ND INTO NORTHERN MN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS PARTS OF THE NRN GREAT BASIN AND NRN ROCKIES DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A FEW STORMS MAY BECOME SEVERE...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE AND MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SUGGEST CONVECTIVE INITIATION UNDERWAY -- LIKELY BOLSTERED BY STRENGTHENING OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS AND DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING-INDUCED BAROCLINICITY ON THE PERIPHERY OF A MID-LEVEL CLOUD BAND EXTENDING NEWD ACROSS CNTRL ID INTO SW MT. MEANWHILE...A BAND OF MODERATE MID-LEVEL WSWLYS/SWLYS OVERLYING THE REGION CONTINUES TO SUSTAIN A PLUME OF ENHANCED MID-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS THE AREA. IN TURN...SFC DEWPOINTS ARE HOLDING IN THE MIDDLE 40S TO LOWER 50S AS PBL CIRCULATIONS DIURNALLY DEEPEN...WHILE THE MOISTURE ALOFT FACILITATES SHELTERING OF INCIPIENT UPDRAFTS. AS SUCH...WITH MANY AREAS OF AMPLE INSOLATION -- PARTICULARLY S OF THE MT BORDER -- THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. MODIFICATIONS TO AREA 12Z RAOBS TO ACCOUNT FOR CURRENT SFC CONDITIONS SUGGEST SBCAPE AROUND 500-1500 J/KG...AIDED BY STEEP TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES SUPERIMPOSED WITH MODEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. AND...WITH 30-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR ATTENDANT TO THE ENHANCED FLOW ALOFT...SUSTAINED AND LOCALLY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES -- INCLUDING POSSIBLE MARGINAL/TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS -- MAY OCCUR. ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MOST INTENSE STORMS. HOWEVER...WITH A MID-LEVEL RIDGE BUILDING NWD INTO THE REGION AND ATTENDANT HEIGHT RISES THROUGH PEAK HEATING...THE COVERAGE OF SVR STORMS SHOULD BE TOO MINIMAL FOR WW ISSUANCE -- ESPECIALLY WITHOUT STRONGER BUOYANCY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...AND ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY HIGHLIGHTS THE ONSET OF DIURNAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE CNTRL GREAT BASIN AND VICINITY. THUNDERSTORMS ARE LIKELY TO BLOSSOM FROM TOWERING CU CURRENTLY ALONG THE CREST OF THE SIERRA IN FAR E-CNTRL CA...AND ALONG TERRAIN-DRIVEN CIRCULATIONS FOCUSED ON MOUNTAIN RANGES OF CNTRL NV...WHERE WIDESPREAD STRONG INSOLATION IS ONGOING. FARTHER TO THE NW...A MID-LEVEL CLOUD BAND DRAPED FROM NRN CA TO NWRN NV APPEARS TO BE THINNING IN SOME AREAS...BUT IS STILL OFFERING DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG ITS PERIPHERY TO ENHANCE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE RELATED TO ATTENDANT BAROCLINIC CIRCULATIONS...ALONG WITH EVENTUAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. FURTHERMORE... MESO-BETA-SCALE CIRCULATIONS -- PERHAPS DRIVEN BY ANTECEDENT CONVECTION -- ARE STREAMING NEWD IN THIS CLOUD BAND FROM PERSHING COUNTY TO HUMBOLDT COUNTY...AND MAY ALSO ENCOURAGE ASCENT AND STORM FORMATION ALONG THEIR PERIPHERIES. MORE CLOUD-FREE AREAS NW OF THIS BAND ARE ENHANCING SFC HEATING/DESTABILIZATION AND OPPORTUNITIES FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT INTO FAR SERN ORE AND ADJACENT NWRN NV. STORMS EVOLVING FROM THESE VARIOUS REGIMES ARE EXPECTED TO ADVANCE NEWD/ENEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. WITH ENHANCED TROPOSPHERIC MOISTURE IN PLACE -- E.G. PW VALUES AROUND 1 INCH PER GPS DATA -- SFC DEWPOINTS ARE HOLDING IN THE MIDDLE 40S TO LOWER 50S -- TO FOSTER 500-1500 J/KG OF SBCAPE PER MODIFICATIONS TO THE 12Z ELKO RAOB. A FEW STRONG UPDRAFTS/DOWNDRAFTS MAY ENSUE...WITH STEEP TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES IN PLACE. ALSO...WITH MODERATE SWLYS OVERLYING THE REGION...25-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR LOCALLY ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES -- INCLUDING MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND PERHAPS ONE OR TWO TRANSIENT/MARGINAL SUPERCELLS. ISOLATED INSTANCES OF SVR WIND GUSTS MAY ENSUE. HOWEVER...WITH A DEART

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THERE WILL EXIST THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DMGG THUNDERSTORM WINDS TO OCCUR INTO THE EARLY EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS. HOWEVER...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES CONTINUE TO STEEPEN AS SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE MIDDLE 90S TO AROUND 105F. WITH THE REGION BEING ON THE WRN FRINGES OF RICHER GULF MOISTURE...MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG IS COMMON ACROSS THE AREA WITH LITTLE CAPPING. THESE FACTORS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO SUPPORTING ROBUST UPDRAFTS...AS CONVECTION DEEPENS AMIDST IN A VARIETY OF REGIMES: /1/ STORMS DEVELOPING OVER THE SANGRE DE CRISTO MOUNTAINS AND SPREADING INTO HIGHER-THETA-E AIR OVER THE ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS... /2/ TOWERING CU AND ISOLATED STORMS DEVELOPING IN PROXIMITY TO A LEE TROUGH THAT EXTENDS FROM CNTRL NEB TO W-CNTRL KS AND FARTHER SW INTO NERN NM... /3/ SOLENOIDS OFFERED BY DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG THE FRINGES OF A BROKEN...NE/SW-ORIENTED MULTI-LAYERED CLOUD BAND EXTENDING FROM THE PALMER DIVIDE VICINITY TO CNTRL NEB... /4/ DIURNALLY DEEPENING PBL CIRCULATIONS INTERMIXED ACROSS THE ABOVE-MENTIONED REGIMES AND ELSEWHERE ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. WATER VAPOR LOOPS SUGGEST THAT DEEP-LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE NEGLIGIBLE. HOWEVER...HIGH DCAPE -- ON THE ORDER OF 1000-2000 J/KG -- WILL PROMOTE STRONG DOWNDRAFTS CAPABLE OF DMGG WIND GUSTS...ALONG WITH SURGING COLD POOLS TO FOCUS REGENERATIVE CONVECTION EWD/SEWD INTO HIGHER THETA-E AIR E OVER THE HIGH PLAINS INTO THE EVENING HOURS. WHILE COALESCING COLD POOLS WITH LOOSELY ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH LOCALLY ENHANCED SFC WIND GUSTS...EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR MAGNITUDES GENERALLY AOB 25 KT SHOULD KEEP CONVECTION LARGELY DISORGANIZED. THIS IS EXPECTED TO PREVENT A MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR-TSTM RISK FROM EVOLVING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL/SOME TORNADO RISK IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THIS AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...THE POTENTIAL FOR WIDESPREAD/INTENSE DAMAGING WINDS IS OTHERWISE EXPECTED TO STEADILY INCREASE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS ND. TORNADO WATCH 426 CONTINUES UNTIL 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS ACROSS WEST/SOUTHWEST ND HAVE QUICKLY CONGEALED INTO A LOOSELY ORGANIZED LINEAR COMPLEX AS OF 20Z...WITH A SOUTH-END SUPERCELL NOTED TO BE NEARING THE I-94 VICINITY AROUND/JUST EAST OF DICKINSON. A LARGE HAIL/TORNADO RISK IS POSSIBLE WITH THIS STORM...AND/OR OTHER GRADUALLY INCREASING DEVELOPMENT ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL ND...ESPECIALLY IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE BOUNDARY THAT ANGLES GENERALLY SOUTHWEST-NORTHEAST ACROSS ND. HOWEVER...THE DEVELOPMENT/MATURATION OF A SPATIALLY EXPANDING QUASI-LINEAR MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WILL LIKELY BE THE PREVALENT SCENARIO. AS THIS SYSTEM CONTINUES TO GROW UPSCALE AND ACCELERATE EAST-NORTHEASTWARD...WIDESPREAD/POTENTIALLY INTENSE DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BECOME AN INCREASING CONCERN BY LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS CENTRAL ND. THIS MCS WILL THRIVE WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT THAT IS CHARACTERIZED BY STRONG TO EXTREME INSTABILITY...WITH 18Z OBSERVED REGIONAL SOUNDINGS/SPC OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUPPORTIVE OF 2500-5000 J/KG MLCAPE ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN ND. ..GUYER.. 07/21/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL/SOME TORNADO RISK WILL CONTINUE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS SOUTHWEST/CENTRAL ND...HOWEVER THE POTENTIAL FOR WIDESPREAD/INTENSE DAMAGING WINDS /POSSIBLE DERECHO/ IS OTHERWISE EXPECTED TO STEADILY INCREASE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS ND INTO NORTHERN MN. TORNADO WATCH 426 CONTINUES ACROSS ND UNTIL 00Z. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT AN ADDITIONAL WATCH IS HIGHLY LIKELY ACROSS EASTERN ND/NORTHERN MN BY EARLY EVENING...WITH ISSUANCE POTENTIALLY AS EARLY AS 22-23Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SURFACE BOUNDARY CONTINUES TO ANGLE GENERALLY SOUTHWEST-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS ND AT MID-AFTERNOON...WITH A VERY MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR MASS LOCATED NEAR/SOUTH OF THE SURFACE FRONT. NEAR THIS BOUNDARY...AN INCREASINGLY WELL-ORGANIZED QUASI-LINEAR COMPLEX CONTINUES TO EVOLVE AS OF 2045Z...WITH A STRONG SOUTH-END SUPERCELL NEAR I-94 EAST OF THE DICKINSON AREA. A LARGE HAIL/TORNADO RISK IS POSSIBLE WITH THIS STORM...AND ANY OTHER SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLULAR DEVELOPMENT NEAR THE SURFACE BOUNDARY ACROSS CENTRAL/NORTHEAST ND. THAT SAID...CURRENT TRENDS SUGGEST THAT THE DEVELOPMENT/MATURATION OF A SPATIALLY EXPANDING QUASI-LINEAR MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WILL LIKELY BE THE PREVALENT SCENARIO INTO THIS EVENING...ESPECIALLY IN VICINITY OF THE AFOREMENTIONED SURFACE BOUNDARY ACROSS ND. AS THIS MCS CONTINUES TO GROW UPSCALE AND GRADUALLY ACCELERATE EAST-NORTHEASTWARD /POTENTIALLY REACHING 50 KT FORWARD MOTION/...WIDESPREAD/POTENTIALLY INTENSE DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BECOME AN INCREASING CONCERN THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN ND. THIS MCS WILL THRIVE WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT THAT IS CHARACTERIZED BY STRONG TO EXTREME INSTABILITY...WITH 18Z OBSERVED REGIONAL SOUNDINGS/20Z SPC OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUPPORTIVE OF 2500-5000 J/KG MLCAPE ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN ND. ..GUYER.. 07/21/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL SPREAD EWD FROM CENTRAL INTO ERN ND AND ADJACENT SD EARLY THIS EVENING...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR GUSTS TO REACH AND/OR EXCEED 55-65 KT...ESPECIALLY OVER SERN TO EAST CENTRAL ND. HAIL WILL REMAIN A THREAT WITH POTENTIAL FOR A BRIEF TORNADO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN RADAR IMAGERY AT BIS INDICATED AN ACCELERATION OF A LINE OF STORMS AS THIS ACTIVITY MOVED EAST OF THE MISSOURI RIVER THROUGH BURLEIGH AND EMMONS COUNTIES ND. AT 2320Z...THIS LINE OF STORMS EXTENDED THROUGH THE COUNTIES OF SERN EMMONS TO WRN LOGAN...KIDDER TO SHERIDAN...WITH PORTIONS OF THE LINE MOVING ENEWD AT 40-45 KT. ADDITIONAL STORMS CONTINUED OVER NERN ND...GENERALLY NORTH OF A BOUNDARY WHICH WAS BEGINNING TO MOVE SWD AND EXTENDED FROM 60 WSW DVL TO 40 W GFK TO 20 N GFK. THE ENVIRONMENT ALONG AND SOUTH OF THIS BOUNDARY REMAINED EXTREMELY UNSTABLE /MLCAPE 4000-5000 J PER KG/. THIS INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH THE FORWARD PROPAGATING LINE OF STORMS BEING ORIENTED PERPENDICULAR TO THE FLOW ALOFT SUGGESTS THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SIGNIFICANT WIND GUSTS SHOULD OCCUR ACROSS SERN AND EAST-CENTRAL ND THROUGH 01-02Z. ..PETERS.. 07/21/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS IS EXPECTED TO THE EAST OF WW 427 BETWEEN 02-03Z...WITH THIS THREAT SPREADING ACROSS MUCH OF NRN AND PARTS OF CENTRAL MN THROUGH THE LATE EVENING INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT. PARTS OF NWRN WI MAY HAVE A THREAT FOR SEVERE STORMS LATER TONIGHT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A BOWING LINE OF STORMS MOVING EWD AT 40-50 KT IN EAST-CENTRAL/SERN ND AND ADJACENT FAR NERN SD. A SURFACE BOUNDARY EXTENDED FROM THE NRN EXTENT OF THIS LINE OF STORMS...ENEWD TO INVOF INL AND THEN INTO ONTARIO TO THE NORTH OF THE MN ARROWHEAD. THE ENVIRONMENT SOUTH OF THIS BOUNDARY REMAINS STRONGLY TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE 2500-4500 J/KG. GIVEN FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMICS...THE WELL ESTABLISHED FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS IS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS EWD THIS EVENING ACROSS NRN AND PARTS OF CENTRAL MN. THE SRN EXTENT OF ANY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD BE MITIGATED BY A CAP AS OBSERVED WITH THE 00Z MPX/ABR SOUNDINGS. SOME INCREASE IN WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS MAY ALSO AID IN AN ENHANCED WIND THREAT AS THIS MCS MOVES EWD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS ASSOCIATED WITH A LARGE BOWING COMPLEX OF THUNDERSTORMS WAS SPREADING EAST INTO WESTERN PORTIONS OF MN. THE BULK OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 427...WITH THE POSSIBLE EXCEPTION OF SOUTHERN AREAS OF NORTHEAST SOUTH DAKOTA AND WEST-CENTRAL MN...WILL LIKELY BE CANCELED BY 0300 UTC/10 PM CDT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MATURE FORWARD-PROPAGATING SEVERE MCS HAS MOVED ACROSS AN INSTABILITY CORRIDOR WHERE CAPE VALUES WERE NEAR 5000 J/KG EARLIER THIS EVENING. THIS INSTABILITY....IN CONCERT WITH STRENGTHENING MID-LEVEL FLOW TO ABOUT 50KT...HAS AIDED SYSTEM ORGANIZATION AND INTENSIFICATION THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS WITH THE APEX OF THE BOW NOW MOVING EAST-NORTHEAST INTO WEST-CENTRAL AND NORTHERN MN AT ABOUT 50KT. WHILE THE LARGER COMPLEX HAS LIKELY PEAKED IN INTENSITY...THE EXTENSIVE COLD POOL AND ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE OF THE COMPLEX WILL MORE THAN LIKELY CONTRIBUTE TO A CONTINUING SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IN THE FORM OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO. FLANKING LINE DEVELOPMENT IS ALSO EVIDENT ON THE TRAILING OUTFLOW MOVING ACROSS NORTHEAST SD AT A SLOWER PACE OF ABOUT 30KT. LIFT ALONG THIS OUTFLOW WILL CONTINUE TO ACT ON SOME OF THE MOST UNSTABLE AIR AVAILABLE WITH A SLIGHT TENDENCY FOR UPDRAFTS TO CONTINUE TO FORM/PERSIST AND POSE A THREAT FOR DOWNBURST WINDS ACROSS NORTHEAST SD AND INTO WEST-CENTRAL MN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN A THREAT AS A LARGE MCS ADVANCES EWD ACROSS NRN AND CENTRAL MN INTO THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. THE SRN EXTENT OF THE LINE OF STORMS WILL PERSIST ACROSS CENTRAL MN AND INTO FAR NWRN WI THROUGH 06-07Z...WHILE THE NRN EXTENT OF THE LINE OF STORMS MOVES THROUGH NERN MN BETWEEN 05-08Z. THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD REMAIN LOW IN THE WAKE OF THE LINE...SUCH THAT THESE COUNTIES CAN BE REMOVED FROM WW 428.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TIME-LAPSE OF MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY LATE THIS EVENING SHOWED A LINE OF STORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS CENTRAL MN AT 45 KT...AND A FORWARD SPEED OF 35-40 KT OVER NORTH-CENTRAL MN. AT 0425Z...THIS LINE EXTENDED FROM CENTRAL KOOCHICHING COUNTY MN TO TODD/POPE COUNTIES MN. A WELL-ESTABLISHED COLD POOL WITH THIS MCS...AND WARM SURFACE TEMPERATURES /UPPER 70S TO LOWER 80S/ AND A RESIDUAL POOL OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MUCAPE 3000-4500 J PER KG/ PRECEDING THE LINE OF STORMS WILL MAINTAIN FORWARD PROPAGATION. GIVEN THESE FACTORS...A THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST...THOUGH A GRADUAL INCREASE IN SURFACE-BASED INHIBITION COULD BECOME A GREATER DETERRENT TO STRONG WINDS REACHING THE SURFACE. ..PETERS.. 07/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MOVING QUICKLY EWD ACROSS E CENTRAL AND NERN MN ARE FORECAST TO BEGIN MOVING OUT OF WW 428 IN THE NEXT HOUR. ISOLATED SEVERE RISK ACCOMPANYING THE STORMS SUGGESTS THAT DOWNSTREAM WW MAY BE REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP SHOWS AN ORGANIZED LINE OF STORMS MOVING EWD THROUGH WW 428 AT AROUND 40 KT...AND APPROACHING THE MN ARROWHEAD...WRN LK SUPERIOR...AND THE MN/WI BORDER ATTM. THE STORMS ARE CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH THE AXIS OF GREATEST INSTABILITY AND WEAKEST CAP PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS...WITH INCREASING DOWNSTREAM CINH LIKELY TO SUPPORT A GRADUAL DECREASE IN OVERALL CONVECTIVE INTENSITY/ORGANIZATION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS STORMS ENCOUNTER THE MORE HOSTILE ENVIRONMENT. THAT SAID...THE MCS REMAINS MATURE/WELL-ORGANIZED...WITH A PRONOUNCED CONVECTIVE LOW NOW MOVING INTO NWRN MN. THUS...EXPECT STORMS/SEVERE RISK TO EXPAND E OF THE WW IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO -- POSSIBLY REQUIRING NEW WATCH ISSUANCE. ..GOSS.. 07/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS CONTINUE MOVING EWD ACROSS WW 429...WHERE ISOLATED SEVERE RISK CONTINUES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A FEW INTENSE CELLS MOVING ACROSS NRN WI AND ADJACENT WRN LOWER MI...WITHIN THE ONGOING BAND OF STORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS WW 429. THOUGH OVERALL INTENSITY/ORGANIZATION OF THE CONVECTION CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY DECREASE...POTENTIAL FOR HAIL AND/OR DAMAGING WINDS IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST WITH THE STRONGEST CELLS ACROSS THE AREA OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. EVENTUALLY...DIMINISHING INSTABILITY OBSERVED WITH EWD EXTENT SHOULD YIELD A DEMISE IN SEVERE RISK -- AND THUS A DOWNSTREAM WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED. ..GOSS.. 07/22/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
